name: Malaysia (Nihon Pigment)
change_summary: Malaysia’s base law from 1 October 2025 (EPF Third Schedule, SOCSO/EIS, MTD 2026, HRDF, EA 1955), plus Nihon Pigment’s incentive-overtime boundary at 11 hours’ total work in a day.

limits.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60A(1)(d): not more than 45 hours of work in one week; s.60A(3) pays the hours beyond at one and a half times the hourly rate
Employment (Limitation of Overtime Work) Regulations 1980 reg. 2

work_rules.authority: Employment Act 1955 First Schedule paras 1A, 2 and 3, as substituted by the Employment (Amendment of First Schedule) Order 2022 [P.U. (A) 262], in operation 1 January 2023 — the ladder in ss.60(3), 60A(3), 60D(3) and 60D(4) does not apply to a person whose wages exceed RM4,000 a month, save for the para 2 categories, which are covered irrespective of wages; para 2(4) vessel work is outside Part XII altogether; "wages" is the s.2 definition less commissions, subsistence allowance and overtime payment. The rest break is s.60A(1)(a): an employee shall not be required to work more than five consecutive hours without a period of leisure of not less than thirty minutes; proviso (i) a break of less than thirty minutes does not break the continuity of the five hours, proviso (ii) work that must be carried on continuously may run eight consecutive hours inclusive of not less than forty-five minutes in the aggregate for a meal. The weekly rest day is s.59(1): every employee shall be allowed in each week a rest day of one whole day as determined from time to time by the employer, and where more than one is allowed the LAST is the rest day for the purposes of Part XII; s.59(1A) treats any continuous period of not less than thirty hours as a rest day for shift work. holiday_rest_precedence is SUBSTITUTE on the s.60D(1) proviso: where a gazetted public holiday falls on a rest day, or on another public holiday, the working day next following is a paid holiday in substitution. APPLIED: (a) the s.60A(1)(b)-(d) statement of normal hours — not more than eight hours in one day ("normal_day"), a spread-over of not more than ten hours ("spread_day") and not more than forty-five hours in one week ("weekly_total") — enforced as schedule limits, while every BEYOND_NORMAL band below prices the overtime it derives; Applied 2026-09-18: s.60A(1)(b) the normal day is 8 hours, or up to 9 under the proviso where the contracted week is within 45 (`normal_hours`); s.60A(1)(d) 45 hours a week is a ceiling on normal hours, the hours beyond it overtime (`weekly_normal`, read by payroll), not a wall on the roster; s.60(3)(a) rest-day work of a daily- or hourly-rated employee pays one day’s wages up to half the normal hours and two days’ beyond (`person.terms.pay_frequency`); s.59(1A) the rest day does not run during maternity, sick or hospitalisation leave (`weekly_rest_rule.suspended_by_leave`); First Schedule para 2(5): a domestic employee is outside ss.60–60F and the overtime ladder (`employment.type != "DOMESTIC"`).

wages.authority: Applied 2026-09-19 (2): Minimum Wages Order 2024 para 3(2): a domestic employee is outside the Order.

encashment.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.2, 60E(3A), 60I(1A)-(1B): monthly wages / 26; weekly basic / 6. Contract allowances are monthly amounts, so qualifying normal-hours allowances add their monthly amount / 26. Excluded payments do not enter the rate.; s.60I(1C) for daily/hourly rates (preceding wage period)

ordinary_rate_reference.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60I(1C): total wages in the preceding wage period over the days actually worked

final_pay_deadlines.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.21(2): an employee who terminates without notice under s.13(1)-(2) or s.14(3) is paid not later than the third day after the termination

Employment Act 1955 s.20 (a contract ending under s.11(1) or by notice under s.12, from either party) and s.21(1) (the employer terminating without notice): not later than the day the contract terminates

tax_clearance.when: employment.exit_reason == "RETIREMENT" || employee.citizenship != "CITIZEN" || ("leaving_malaysia" in employment.exit_fact_keys && employment.exit_facts.leaving_malaysia == true)
tax_clearance.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(3)-(5): notice one month before a retiring employee ceases (the MTD exemption in the s.83(3) proviso does not reach a retiree) or before an employee leaves Malaysia for more than three months; money withheld until ninety days after HASiL receives it; e-SPC

sources.instructions:
Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation in the national law database, the gazette, or the table the authority itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date. Where the primary host refuses the reader (sso.agc.gov.sg, officialgazette.gov.ph, peraturan.bpk.go.id, kwsp.gov.my, hrdcorp.gov.my answer 403 to Norbital-Public-Page-Reader) the authority’s own published table is listed instead, or the Wayback Machine’s dated copy of the authority’s own page or PDF (web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<url>) — never a host the reader cannot open.
lom.agc.gov.my — Laws of Malaysia (AGC): every Act and gazette order. The consolidated reprint of a principal Act is /ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act <n>.pdf (452 EPF, 4 SOCSO, 265 Employment, 53 Income Tax; text); an amending Act is a PDF at /ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/<id>_BI/<Act name>.pdf; a P.U.(A)/(B) order at /ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputp/<id>/PUB <n> (<year>).pdf. Use the exact PDF URL listed; the portal search is script-driven and not readable.
kwsp.gov.my — EPF. /en/employer/responsibilities/mandatory-contribution states the Part A/C/E rates, the age gates and the age-75 stop (HTML). /documents/d/guest/third_schedule_from_-1-october-2025 is the Third Schedule download link (the reader gets a shell page; the 1,203-row table is the PDF behind it). /en/employer/responsibilities/non-malaysian-citizen-employees is Part F.
perkeso.gov.my — SOCSO, EIS, SKBBK. /en/rate-of-contribution.html carries the Act 4 / Act 800 tables; /images/lindung/lindung-24-jam/NewContributionRateIncludingSKBBK.pdf is the 65-row table with the SKBBK column (0.2 MB, text); /en/skim-kemalangan-bukan-bencana-kerja-lindung-24-jam.html holds the SKBBK notice and FAQ PDF.
hasil.gov.my — LHDN MTD. /majikan/jadual-pcb-dan-spesifikasi-data/ lists the yearly "Spesifikasi Kaedah Pengiraan Berkomputer PCB <year>" PDF (/wp-content/uploads/spesifikasi-kaedah-pengiraan-berkomputer-pcb-<year>.pdf, 1.3 MB, text): Table 1 rates, reliefs, the RM10 minimum.
jtksm.mohr.gov.my — Employment Act 1955 reprint: /sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta Kerja 1955 (Akta 265).pdf (1.4 MB, text): ss.60, 60A, 60D, 60E, 60F, First Schedule. /ms/soalan-lazim/akta-kerja-1955-pindaan-2022 is the 2022 amendment FAQ.
gajiminimum.mohr.gov.my — the Minimum Wages Order in force, as one figure on the landing page.
hrdcorp.gov.my — HRD levy; the site sits behind a browser challenge the reader cannot pass, so note it rather than reading it.
johor.gov.my/rakyat/cuti-umum-2 — the Johor state holiday list for the year.

exit_facts.label: Left without notice
exit_facts.description: The employee ended the contract without notice under Employment Act 1955 s.13(1)-(2) or s.14(3); the final wages are then due by the third day after (s.21(2)).

exit_facts.label: Leaving Malaysia for more than three months
exit_facts.description: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(4): the employer gives CP21 notice and withholds money payable under s.83(5).

obligations.description: Written contract of service with a termination clause
obligations.trigger: Hiring on a contract for more than one month or a piece of work that may take more than one month
obligations.timing: In writing at engagement; every written contract carries a clause on how either party may terminate it
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.10(1)-(2) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Wage period and time of payment; payment through a financial institution
obligations.timing: Wage period not more than one month (s.18); wages less lawful deductions paid not later than the seventh day after the last day of the wage period (s.19(1)); rest-day, public-holiday and s.60A overtime pay not later than the last day of the next wage period (s.19(2)); paid into the employee's account (s.25)
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.18, 19, 25 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Statement of wages to each employee
obligations.timing: With each month's wages, in the content the EPF Rules prescribe
obligations.authority: Employees Provident Fund Act 1991 s.42(1) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%20452.pdf); Employment Act 1955 s.62 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf). The engine produces the payslip; delivery is external

obligations.description: Deductions from wages only as the Act permits, within fifty per cent of the month's wages
obligations.trigger: Any deduction from wages other than statutory contributions and tax
obligations.timing: Before the deduction: s.24(3) written request, s.24(4) written request and Director General's prior permission; the total under s.24 in a month may not exceed 50% of wages earned that month, save final-pay and s.24(9) exceptions
obligations.owner: Payroll / employee request and DG permission
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.22, 24(1)-(9) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf). The engine applies only a net-pay floor, not the 50% ceiling

obligations.description: Registers of employees, wages and hours, and tax records
obligations.timing: Employment and EPF registers available for inspection for not less than six years after each entry; business and tax records kept seven years from the end of the year they relate to
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.61(1)-(2) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf); Employees Provident Fund Act 1991 s.42(2) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%20452.pdf); Income Tax Act 1967 s.82(1)(a) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf)

obligations.description: Rest-day roster or fixed rest-day notice
obligations.timing: Before the commencement of the month in which the rest days fall; every roster preserved for six years
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.59(2)-(3) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Notice of the six gazetted holidays chosen for the year
obligations.timing: Exhibited conspicuously at the place of employment before the commencement of each calendar year
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60D(1A) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Daily, weekly and break limits, and permission to exceed them
obligations.timing: Not more than 5 consecutive hours without 30 minutes' leisure, 8 hours a day (9 under proviso (iii)), a 10-hour spread-over and 45 hours a week; never more than 12 hours of work in a day outside the s.60A(2) emergencies; the Director General's written permission before contracting beyond s.60A(1)
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60A(1), (1A), (2), (7) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf). The roster gate refuses a breaching schedule; payroll reports a breaching day

obligations.description: Monthly overtime ceiling and permission to exceed it
obligations.timing: Not more than 104 hours of overtime (hours beyond the normal hours of work per day; rest-day and public-holiday work excluded) in a month, unless the Director General has permitted more on written application beforehand
obligations.owner: HR / overtime register and DG permission
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60A(3)(b), (4)(a) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf); Employment (Limitation of Overtime Work) Regulations 1980 reg.2 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-03/7.%20EMPLOYMENT%20%28LIMITATION%20OF%20OVERTIME%20WORK%29%20REGULATIONS%201980_0.pdf). Payroll reports OVERTIME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; paying an hour as INCENTIVE does not discharge the ceiling

obligations.description: Approval to employ a foreign employee and notices of hire and termination
obligations.trigger: Hiring or termination of a non-resident foreign employee
obligations.timing: Prior approval of the Director General; particulars within fourteen days of employment; termination by the employer, pass expiry or repatriation notified within thirty days; resignation or absconding notified within fourteen days
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.60K(1), (3), 60KA(1)-(2) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Annual levy on a foreign worker's Temporary Employment Visit Pass
obligations.trigger: Issue or renewal of the pass
obligations.timing: Paid by the employer to the Immigration Department at issue and each renewal
obligations.authority: Immigration Department of Malaysia levy on PLKS; the instrument and its current rates were not confirmed from a primary source in this audit

obligations.description: Notice of a new, acquired, renamed or relocated establishment
obligations.trigger: Commencing, taking over, or changing the name or location of an establishment with employees
obligations.timing: Within ninety days, to the nearest Labour office, with the categories and number of employees
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.63A(1), (1A) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: EPF employer registration, cessation notice and monthly contributions
obligations.trigger: Paying wages that attract EPF, including non-citizens under Part F from October 2025 wages
obligations.timing: Register before the end of the first week of the first month wages attract contributions; notify cessation as an employer within thirty days; pay both shares on or before the 15th of the following month; late payment carries the dividend the contributions would have earned (s.45(3))
obligations.owner: Finance / KWSP registration and payment receipt
obligations.authority: Employees Provident Fund Act 1991 ss.41(1), (3), 43(1)-(2), 45(1)-(3) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%20452.pdf); KWSP mandatory contribution page (https://web.archive.org/web/20260810072920id_/https://www.kwsp.gov.my/en/employer/responsibilities/mandatory-contribution). The engine computes the contribution; registration and payment are external

obligations.description: PERKESO employer and employee registration and monthly SOCSO / EIS contributions
obligations.trigger: Hiring an employee covered by Act 4 or Act 800
obligations.timing: Employer and employee registered within 30 days of hiring (Borang 1, Borang 2); contributions for a month paid no later than the 15th of the following month; late payment interest 6% a year for each day late
obligations.owner: Finance / ASSIST registration and payment receipt
obligations.authority: Employees' Social Security Act 1969 and Employment Insurance System Act 2017, as administered by PERKESO (https://www.perkeso.gov.my/en/pemerkasa/184-our-services/775-registration.html; https://www.perkeso.gov.my/en/uncategorised/801-contribution-payment.html). The engine computes the contributions; registration and payment are external

obligations.description: Report of a work-related accident
obligations.timing: Within 48 hours of notification
obligations.authority: Employees' Social Security Act 1969; PERKESO employer responsibilities (https://perkeso.gov.my/en/our-services/employer-employee/employer-registration/)

obligations.description: HRD Corp registration and monthly levy
obligations.trigger: Ten or more Malaysian employees (compulsory, 1%); five to nine (optional, 0.5%)
obligations.timing: Register within the prescribed time; notify HRD Corp within thirty days of ceasing to be an employer; levy on each month's wages (basic salary and fixed allowances, leave pay and arrears) paid monthly — by the 15th of the following month per HRD Corp
obligations.authority: Pembangunan Sumber Manusia Berhad Act 2001 ss.13(1), (3), 14(1), 15(1)-(2) and s.2 "upah" (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-03/10.%20Akta%20Pembangunan%20Sumber%20Manusia%202001.pdf). The engine computes the levy; the payment date rests on HRD Corp guidance the audit could not open (hrdcorp.gov.my refuses the reader)

obligations.description: Monthly tax deduction (PCB) remittance and data (CP39), including CP38 directions
obligations.timing: Remitted with the MTD data on or before the 15th day of the following month; a CP38 direction deducted as instructed
obligations.owner: Finance / e-PCB or e-Data PCB receipt
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.107(1) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf); Income Tax (Deduction from Remuneration) Rules 1994; HASiL employer responsibilities (https://www.hasil.gov.my/en/majikan/tanggungjawab-majikan/). The engine computes PCB and CP38; submission is external

obligations.description: Notice of a new employee (CP22)
obligations.trigger: Commencing to employ an individual who is or is likely to be chargeable to tax
obligations.timing: Not later than one month after the commencement
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(2) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf)

obligations.description: Cessation or departure notice (CP22A / CP21) and withholding of money
obligations.trigger: An employee ceasing employment, retiring, or leaving Malaysia for more than three months
obligations.timing: Not less than one month before cessation or departure, through e-SPC from 1 January 2024 (no CP22A where the income is subject to MTD, or below the MTD threshold, and the individual is not retiring); money payable withheld until ninety days after HASiL receives the notice, unless HASiL permits earlier
obligations.owner: Payroll and HR / e-SPC notice and clearance letter
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(3)-(5) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf); HASiL notification of termination (https://www.hasil.gov.my/en/majikan/pemberitahuan-pemberhentian-kerja/). The engine raises a disbursement hold from payroll.tax_clearance

obligations.description: Annual remuneration statement to each employee (Form EA)
obligations.timing: Prepared and rendered to the employee on or before the last day of February of the following year
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(1A); HASiL employer responsibilities (https://www.hasil.gov.my/en/majikan/tanggungjawab-majikan/)

obligations.description: Employer's return (Form E) with the CP8D employee particulars
obligations.timing: On or before 31 March of the following year; Form E is incomplete without CP8D
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(1) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf); HASiL employer responsibilities (https://www.hasil.gov.my/en/majikan/tanggungjawab-majikan/)

obligations.description: Minimum wage
obligations.timing: RM1,700 a month (the hourly and daily equivalents for other rates) under the Minimum Wages Order 2024, in force for every employer from 1 August 2025
obligations.authority: National Wages Consultative Council Act 2011; Minimum Wages Order 2024 (https://gajiminimum.mohr.gov.my/). The engine warns on a covered contract below the floor

obligations.description: Retrenchment notification (Borang PK)
obligations.trigger: Retrenchment by reason of redundancy or closure
obligations.timing: Parts I-IV received by the Labour Department at least 30 days before the retrenchment; Part V within 14 days after; Part VI within 30 days after. Foreign employees in a similar capacity are terminated first (s.60N)
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.60N, 63 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf); Pemberitahuan Pemberhentian Kerja 2004, P.U.(B) 430/2004 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/ms/soalan-lazim/pemberhentian-pekerja; https://www.jtksabah.gov.my/index.php/ms/sumber/media/koleksi-pengumuman/64-perkhidmatan/majikan/164-pemberhentian-pekerja.html)

obligations.description: Notice, termination benefits and final wages
obligations.trigger: Termination of a contract of service
obligations.timing: Notice under s.12(2) (four, six or eight weeks by service) or indemnity in lieu; termination benefits under the Termination and Lay-Off Benefits Regulations 1980; final wages not later than the day the contract ends (s.20, s.21(1)), or the third day after it where the employee left without notice (s.21(2))
obligations.owner: HR and Payroll / service calculation and payment receipt
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.12, 13, 20, 21, 60J (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf). The engine prices TERMINATION_BENEFIT and NOTICE_IN_LIEU and warns FINAL_PAY_LATE

obligations.description: Paternity leave eligibility and notice
obligations.timing: Seven consecutive days per confinement, up to five confinements, after twelve months with the employer; the employee notifies the pregnancy at least thirty days before the expected confinement or as early as possible after the birth
obligations.owner: HR / notice, marriage and confinement evidence
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60FA(1)-(3) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Work authorisation, privacy and workplace safety
obligations.timing: Per the applicable instrument
obligations.owner: HR / applicable-law register, permits and retained evidence
obligations.authority: Separate compliance review required; these areas are not implemented by the payroll engine

exit_facts.label: Left without notice
exit_facts.description: The employee ended the contract without notice under Employment Act 1955 s.13(1)-(2) or s.14(3); the final wages are then due by the third day after (s.21(2)).

exit_facts.label: Leaving Malaysia for more than three months
exit_facts.description: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(4): the employer gives CP21 notice and withholds money payable under s.83(5).

obligations.description: Written contract of service with a termination clause
obligations.trigger: Hiring on a contract for more than one month or a piece of work that may take more than one month
obligations.timing: In writing at engagement; every written contract carries a clause on how either party may terminate it
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.10(1)-(2) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Wage period and time of payment; payment through a financial institution
obligations.timing: Wage period not more than one month (s.18); wages less lawful deductions paid not later than the seventh day after the last day of the wage period (s.19(1)); rest-day, public-holiday and s.60A overtime pay not later than the last day of the next wage period (s.19(2)); paid into the employee's account (s.25)
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.18, 19, 25 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Statement of wages to each employee
obligations.timing: With each month's wages, in the content the EPF Rules prescribe
obligations.authority: Employees Provident Fund Act 1991 s.42(1) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%20452.pdf); Employment Act 1955 s.62 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf). The engine produces the payslip; delivery is external

obligations.description: Deductions from wages only as the Act permits, within fifty per cent of the month's wages
obligations.trigger: Any deduction from wages other than statutory contributions and tax
obligations.timing: Before the deduction: s.24(3) written request, s.24(4) written request and Director General's prior permission; the total under s.24 in a month may not exceed 50% of wages earned that month, save final-pay and s.24(9) exceptions
obligations.owner: Payroll / employee request and DG permission
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.22, 24(1)-(9) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf). The engine applies only a net-pay floor, not the 50% ceiling

obligations.description: Registers of employees, wages and hours, and tax records
obligations.timing: Employment and EPF registers available for inspection for not less than six years after each entry; business and tax records kept seven years from the end of the year they relate to
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.61(1)-(2) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf); Employees Provident Fund Act 1991 s.42(2) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%20452.pdf); Income Tax Act 1967 s.82(1)(a) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf)

obligations.description: Rest-day roster or fixed rest-day notice
obligations.timing: Before the commencement of the month in which the rest days fall; every roster preserved for six years
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.59(2)-(3) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Notice of the six gazetted holidays chosen for the year
obligations.timing: Exhibited conspicuously at the place of employment before the commencement of each calendar year
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60D(1A) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Daily, weekly and break limits, and permission to exceed them
obligations.timing: Not more than 5 consecutive hours without 30 minutes' leisure, 8 hours a day (9 under proviso (iii)), a 10-hour spread-over and 45 hours a week; never more than 12 hours of work in a day outside the s.60A(2) emergencies; the Director General's written permission before contracting beyond s.60A(1)
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60A(1), (1A), (2), (7) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf). The roster gate refuses a breaching schedule; payroll reports a breaching day

obligations.description: Monthly overtime ceiling and permission to exceed it
obligations.timing: Not more than 104 hours of overtime (hours beyond the normal hours of work per day; rest-day and public-holiday work excluded) in a month, unless the Director General has permitted more on written application beforehand
obligations.owner: HR / overtime register and DG permission
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60A(3)(b), (4)(a) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf); Employment (Limitation of Overtime Work) Regulations 1980 reg.2 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-03/7.%20EMPLOYMENT%20%28LIMITATION%20OF%20OVERTIME%20WORK%29%20REGULATIONS%201980_0.pdf). Payroll reports OVERTIME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; paying an hour as INCENTIVE does not discharge the ceiling

obligations.description: Approval to employ a foreign employee and notices of hire and termination
obligations.trigger: Hiring or termination of a non-resident foreign employee
obligations.timing: Prior approval of the Director General; particulars within fourteen days of employment; termination by the employer, pass expiry or repatriation notified within thirty days; resignation or absconding notified within fourteen days
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.60K(1), (3), 60KA(1)-(2) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Annual levy on a foreign worker's Temporary Employment Visit Pass
obligations.trigger: Issue or renewal of the pass
obligations.timing: Paid by the employer to the Immigration Department at issue and each renewal
obligations.authority: Immigration Department of Malaysia levy on PLKS; the instrument and its current rates were not confirmed from a primary source in this audit

obligations.description: Notice of a new, acquired, renamed or relocated establishment
obligations.trigger: Commencing, taking over, or changing the name or location of an establishment with employees
obligations.timing: Within ninety days, to the nearest Labour office, with the categories and number of employees
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.63A(1), (1A) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: EPF employer registration, cessation notice and monthly contributions
obligations.trigger: Paying wages that attract EPF, including non-citizens under Part F from October 2025 wages
obligations.timing: Register before the end of the first week of the first month wages attract contributions; notify cessation as an employer within thirty days; pay both shares on or before the 15th of the following month; late payment carries the dividend the contributions would have earned (s.45(3))
obligations.owner: Finance / KWSP registration and payment receipt
obligations.authority: Employees Provident Fund Act 1991 ss.41(1), (3), 43(1)-(2), 45(1)-(3) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%20452.pdf); KWSP mandatory contribution page (https://web.archive.org/web/20260810072920id_/https://www.kwsp.gov.my/en/employer/responsibilities/mandatory-contribution). The engine computes the contribution; registration and payment are external

obligations.description: PERKESO employer and employee registration and monthly SOCSO / EIS contributions
obligations.trigger: Hiring an employee covered by Act 4 or Act 800
obligations.timing: Employer and employee registered within 30 days of hiring (Borang 1, Borang 2); contributions for a month paid no later than the 15th of the following month; late payment interest 6% a year for each day late
obligations.owner: Finance / ASSIST registration and payment receipt
obligations.authority: Employees' Social Security Act 1969 and Employment Insurance System Act 2017, as administered by PERKESO (https://www.perkeso.gov.my/en/pemerkasa/184-our-services/775-registration.html; https://www.perkeso.gov.my/en/uncategorised/801-contribution-payment.html). The engine computes the contributions; registration and payment are external

obligations.description: LINDUNG 24 Jam (SKBBK) employee contribution
obligations.timing: Deducted from wages and paid with the SOCSO contribution by the 15th of the following month
obligations.authority: Employees' Social Security Act 1969 (Act 4), SKBBK in operation 1 June 2026 (https://www.perkeso.gov.my/en/skim-kemalangan-bukan-bencana-kerja-lindung-24-jam.html)

obligations.description: Report of a work-related accident
obligations.timing: Within 48 hours of notification
obligations.authority: Employees' Social Security Act 1969; PERKESO employer responsibilities (https://perkeso.gov.my/en/our-services/employer-employee/employer-registration/)

obligations.description: HRD Corp registration and monthly levy
obligations.trigger: Ten or more Malaysian employees (compulsory, 1%); five to nine (optional, 0.5%)
obligations.timing: Register within the prescribed time; notify HRD Corp within thirty days of ceasing to be an employer; levy on each month's wages (basic salary and fixed allowances, leave pay and arrears) paid monthly — by the 15th of the following month per HRD Corp
obligations.authority: Pembangunan Sumber Manusia Berhad Act 2001 ss.13(1), (3), 14(1), 15(1)-(2) and s.2 "upah" (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-03/10.%20Akta%20Pembangunan%20Sumber%20Manusia%202001.pdf). obligations.description: Monthly tax deduction (PCB) remittance and data (CP39), including CP38 directions
obligations.timing: Remitted with the MTD data on or before the 15th day of the following month; a CP38 direction deducted as instructed
obligations.owner: Finance / e-PCB or e-Data PCB receipt
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.107(1) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf); Income Tax (Deduction from Remuneration) Rules 1994; HASiL employer responsibilities (https://www.hasil.gov.my/en/majikan/tanggungjawab-majikan/). obligations.description: Notice of a new employee (CP22)
obligations.trigger: Commencing to employ an individual who is or is likely to be chargeable to tax
obligations.timing: Not later than one month after the commencement
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(2) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf)

obligations.description: Cessation or departure notice (CP22A / CP21) and withholding of money
obligations.trigger: An employee ceasing employment, retiring, or leaving Malaysia for more than three months
obligations.timing: Not less than one month before cessation or departure, through e-SPC from 1 January 2024 (no CP22A where the income is subject to MTD, or below the MTD threshold, and the individual is not retiring); money payable withheld until ninety days after HASiL receives the notice, unless HASiL permits earlier
obligations.owner: Payroll and HR / e-SPC notice and clearance letter
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(3)-(5) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf); HASiL notification of termination (https://www.hasil.gov.my/en/majikan/pemberitahuan-pemberhentian-kerja/). The engine raises a disbursement hold from payroll.tax_clearance

obligations.description: Annual remuneration statement to each employee (Form EA)
obligations.timing: Prepared and rendered to the employee on or before the last day of February of the following year
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(1A); HASiL employer responsibilities (https://www.hasil.gov.my/en/majikan/tanggungjawab-majikan/)

obligations.description: Employer's return (Form E) with the CP8D employee particulars
obligations.timing: On or before 31 March of the following year; Form E is incomplete without CP8D
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(1) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf); HASiL employer responsibilities (https://www.hasil.gov.my/en/majikan/tanggungjawab-majikan/)

obligations.description: Minimum wage
obligations.timing: RM1,700 a month (the hourly and daily equivalents for other rates) under the Minimum Wages Order 2024, in force for every employer from 1 August 2025
obligations.authority: National Wages Consultative Council Act 2011; Minimum Wages Order 2024 (https://gajiminimum.mohr.gov.my/). The engine warns on a covered contract below the floor

obligations.description: Retrenchment notification (Borang PK)
obligations.trigger: Retrenchment by reason of redundancy or closure
obligations.timing: Parts I-IV received by the Labour Department at least 30 days before the retrenchment; Part V within 14 days after; Part VI within 30 days after. Foreign employees in a similar capacity are terminated first (s.60N)
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.60N, 63 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf); Pemberitahuan Pemberhentian Kerja 2004, P.U.(B) 430/2004 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/ms/soalan-lazim/pemberhentian-pekerja; https://www.jtksabah.gov.my/index.php/ms/sumber/media/koleksi-pengumuman/64-perkhidmatan/majikan/164-pemberhentian-pekerja.html)

obligations.description: Notice, termination benefits and final wages
obligations.trigger: Termination of a contract of service
obligations.timing: Notice under s.12(2) (four, six or eight weeks by service) or indemnity in lieu; termination benefits under the Termination and Lay-Off Benefits Regulations 1980; final wages not later than the day the contract ends (s.20, s.21(1)), or the third day after it where the employee left without notice (s.21(2))
obligations.owner: HR and Payroll / service calculation and payment receipt
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.12, 13, 20, 21, 60J (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf). The engine prices TERMINATION_BENEFIT and NOTICE_IN_LIEU and warns FINAL_PAY_LATE

obligations.description: Paternity leave eligibility and notice
obligations.timing: Seven consecutive days per confinement, up to five confinements, after twelve months with the employer; the employee notifies the pregnancy at least thirty days before the expected confinement or as early as possible after the birth
obligations.owner: HR / notice, marriage and confinement evidence
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60FA(1)-(3) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Work authorisation, privacy and workplace safety
obligations.timing: Per the applicable instrument
obligations.owner: HR / applicable-law register, permits and retained evidence
obligations.authority: Separate compliance review required; these areas are not implemented by the payroll engine

name: Malaysia (Nihon Pigment) — 2026-07-08
change_summary: SKBBK becomes voluntary for locals on 8 July 2026 and stays mandatory for foreign workers; Nihon’s incentive boundary is unchanged.

limits.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60A(1)(d): not more than 45 hours of work in one week; s.60A(3) pays the hours beyond at one and a half times the hourly rate
Employment (Limitation of Overtime Work) Regulations 1980 reg. 2

work_rules.authority: Employment Act 1955 First Schedule paras 1A, 2 and 3, as substituted by the Employment (Amendment of First Schedule) Order 2022 [P.U. (A) 262], in operation 1 January 2023 — the ladder in ss.60(3), 60A(3), 60D(3) and 60D(4) does not apply to a person whose wages exceed RM4,000 a month, save for the para 2 categories, which are covered irrespective of wages; para 2(4) vessel work is outside Part XII altogether; "wages" is the s.2 definition less commissions, subsistence allowance and overtime payment. The rest break is s.60A(1)(a): an employee shall not be required to work more than five consecutive hours without a period of leisure of not less than thirty minutes; proviso (i) a break of less than thirty minutes does not break the continuity of the five hours, proviso (ii) work that must be carried on continuously may run eight consecutive hours inclusive of not less than forty-five minutes in the aggregate for a meal. The weekly rest day is s.59(1): every employee shall be allowed in each week a rest day of one whole day as determined from time to time by the employer, and where more than one is allowed the LAST is the rest day for the purposes of Part XII; s.59(1A) treats any continuous period of not less than thirty hours as a rest day for shift work. holiday_rest_precedence is SUBSTITUTE on the s.60D(1) proviso: where a gazetted public holiday falls on a rest day, or on another public holiday, the working day next following is a paid holiday in substitution. APPLIED: (a) the s.60A(1)(b)-(d) statement of normal hours — not more than eight hours in one day ("normal_day"), a spread-over of not more than ten hours ("spread_day") and not more than forty-five hours in one week ("weekly_total") — enforced as schedule limits, while every BEYOND_NORMAL band below prices the overtime it derives; Applied 2026-09-18: s.60A(1)(b) the normal day is 8 hours, or up to 9 under the proviso where the contracted week is within 45 (`normal_hours`); s.60A(1)(d) 45 hours a week is a ceiling on normal hours, the hours beyond it overtime (`weekly_normal`, read by payroll), not a wall on the roster; s.60(3)(a) rest-day work of a daily- or hourly-rated employee pays one day’s wages up to half the normal hours and two days’ beyond (`person.terms.pay_frequency`); s.59(1A) the rest day does not run during maternity, sick or hospitalisation leave (`weekly_rest_rule.suspended_by_leave`); First Schedule para 2(5): a domestic employee is outside ss.60–60F and the overtime ladder (`employment.type != "DOMESTIC"`).

wages.authority: Applied 2026-09-19 (2): Minimum Wages Order 2024 para 3(2): a domestic employee is outside the Order.

encashment.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.2, 60E(3A), 60I(1A)-(1B): monthly wages / 26; weekly basic / 6. Contract allowances are monthly amounts, so qualifying normal-hours allowances add their monthly amount / 26. Excluded payments do not enter the rate.; s.60I(1C) for daily/hourly rates (preceding wage period)

ordinary_rate_reference.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60I(1C): total wages in the preceding wage period over the days actually worked

final_pay_deadlines.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.21(2): an employee who terminates without notice under s.13(1)-(2) or s.14(3) is paid not later than the third day after the termination

Employment Act 1955 s.20 (a contract ending under s.11(1) or by notice under s.12, from either party) and s.21(1) (the employer terminating without notice): not later than the day the contract terminates

obligations.description: Statement of wages to each employee
obligations.timing: With each month's wages, in the content the EPF Rules prescribe
obligations.authority: Employees Provident Fund Act 1991 s.42(1) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%20452.pdf); Employment Act 1955 s.62 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf). The engine produces the payslip; delivery is external

obligations.description: Deductions from wages only as the Act permits, within fifty per cent of the month's wages
obligations.trigger: Any deduction from wages other than statutory contributions and tax
obligations.timing: Before the deduction: s.24(3) written request, s.24(4) written request and Director General's prior permission; the total under s.24 in a month may not exceed 50% of wages earned that month, save final-pay and s.24(9) exceptions
obligations.owner: Payroll / employee request and DG permission
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.22, 24(1)-(9) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf). The engine applies only a net-pay floor, not the 50% ceiling

obligations.description: Registers of employees, wages and hours, and tax records
obligations.timing: Employment and EPF registers available for inspection for not less than six years after each entry; business and tax records kept seven years from the end of the year they relate to
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.61(1)-(2) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf); Employees Provident Fund Act 1991 s.42(2) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%20452.pdf); Income Tax Act 1967 s.82(1)(a) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf)

obligations.description: Rest-day roster or fixed rest-day notice
obligations.timing: Before the commencement of the month in which the rest days fall; every roster preserved for six years
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.59(2)-(3) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Notice of the six gazetted holidays chosen for the year
obligations.timing: Exhibited conspicuously at the place of employment before the commencement of each calendar year
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60D(1A) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Daily, weekly and break limits, and permission to exceed them
obligations.timing: Not more than 5 consecutive hours without 30 minutes' leisure, 8 hours a day (9 under proviso (iii)), a 10-hour spread-over and 45 hours a week; never more than 12 hours of work in a day outside the s.60A(2) emergencies; the Director General's written permission before contracting beyond s.60A(1)
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60A(1), (1A), (2), (7) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf). The roster gate refuses a breaching schedule; payroll reports a breaching day

obligations.description: Monthly overtime ceiling and permission to exceed it
obligations.timing: Not more than 104 hours of overtime (hours beyond the normal hours of work per day; rest-day and public-holiday work excluded) in a month, unless the Director General has permitted more on written application beforehand
obligations.owner: HR / overtime register and DG permission
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60A(3)(b), (4)(a) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf); Employment (Limitation of Overtime Work) Regulations 1980 reg.2 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-03/7.%20EMPLOYMENT%20%28LIMITATION%20OF%20OVERTIME%20WORK%29%20REGULATIONS%201980_0.pdf). Payroll reports OVERTIME_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; paying an hour as INCENTIVE does not discharge the ceiling

obligations.description: Approval to employ a foreign employee and notices of hire and termination
obligations.trigger: Hiring or termination of a non-resident foreign employee
obligations.timing: Prior approval of the Director General; particulars within fourteen days of employment; termination by the employer, pass expiry or repatriation notified within thirty days; resignation or absconding notified within fourteen days
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.60K(1), (3), 60KA(1)-(2) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Annual levy on a foreign worker's Temporary Employment Visit Pass
obligations.trigger: Issue or renewal of the pass
obligations.timing: Paid by the employer to the Immigration Department at issue and each renewal
obligations.authority: Immigration Department of Malaysia levy on PLKS; the instrument and its current rates were not confirmed from a primary source in this audit

obligations.description: Notice of a new, acquired, renamed or relocated establishment
obligations.trigger: Commencing, taking over, or changing the name or location of an establishment with employees
obligations.timing: Within ninety days, to the nearest Labour office, with the categories and number of employees
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.63A(1), (1A) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: EPF employer registration, cessation notice and monthly contributions
obligations.trigger: Paying wages that attract EPF, including non-citizens under Part F from October 2025 wages
obligations.timing: Register before the end of the first week of the first month wages attract contributions; notify cessation as an employer within thirty days; pay both shares on or before the 15th of the following month; late payment carries the dividend the contributions would have earned (s.45(3))
obligations.owner: Finance / KWSP registration and payment receipt
obligations.authority: Employees Provident Fund Act 1991 ss.41(1), (3), 43(1)-(2), 45(1)-(3) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%20452.pdf); KWSP mandatory contribution page (https://web.archive.org/web/20260810072920id_/https://www.kwsp.gov.my/en/employer/responsibilities/mandatory-contribution). The engine computes the contribution; registration and payment are external

obligations.description: PERKESO employer and employee registration and monthly SOCSO / EIS contributions
obligations.trigger: Hiring an employee covered by Act 4 or Act 800
obligations.timing: Employer and employee registered within 30 days of hiring (Borang 1, Borang 2); contributions for a month paid no later than the 15th of the following month; late payment interest 6% a year for each day late
obligations.owner: Finance / ASSIST registration and payment receipt
obligations.authority: Employees' Social Security Act 1969 and Employment Insurance System Act 2017, as administered by PERKESO (https://www.perkeso.gov.my/en/pemerkasa/184-our-services/775-registration.html; https://www.perkeso.gov.my/en/uncategorised/801-contribution-payment.html). The engine computes the contributions; registration and payment are external

obligations.description: LINDUNG 24 Jam (SKBBK) employee contribution
obligations.timing: Deducted from wages and paid with the SOCSO contribution by the 15th of the following month; from 8 July 2026 a citizen or permanent resident who filed the TIDAK MENYERTAI release (window 13 July to 31 August 2026) is outside it, recorded as NOT_REGISTERED; foreign workers remain mandatory
obligations.authority: Employees' Social Security Act 1969 (Act 4), SKBBK in operation 1 June 2026 (https://www.perkeso.gov.my/en/skim-kemalangan-bukan-bencana-kerja-lindung-24-jam.html)

obligations.description: Report of a work-related accident
obligations.timing: Within 48 hours of notification
obligations.authority: Employees' Social Security Act 1969; PERKESO employer responsibilities (https://perkeso.gov.my/en/our-services/employer-employee/employer-registration/)

obligations.description: HRD Corp registration and monthly levy
obligations.trigger: Ten or more Malaysian employees (compulsory, 1%); five to nine (optional, 0.5%)
obligations.timing: Register within the prescribed time; notify HRD Corp within thirty days of ceasing to be an employer; levy on each month's wages (basic salary and fixed allowances, leave pay and arrears) paid monthly — by the 15th of the following month per HRD Corp
obligations.authority: Pembangunan Sumber Manusia Berhad Act 2001 ss.13(1), (3), 14(1), 15(1)-(2) and s.2 "upah" (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-03/10.%20Akta%20Pembangunan%20Sumber%20Manusia%202001.pdf). The engine computes the levy; the payment date rests on HRD Corp guidance the audit could not open (hrdcorp.gov.my refuses the reader)

obligations.description: Monthly tax deduction (PCB) remittance and data (CP39), including CP38 directions
obligations.timing: Remitted with the MTD data on or before the 15th day of the following month; a CP38 direction deducted as instructed
obligations.owner: Finance / e-PCB or e-Data PCB receipt
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.107(1) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf); Income Tax (Deduction from Remuneration) Rules 1994; HASiL employer responsibilities (https://www.hasil.gov.my/en/majikan/tanggungjawab-majikan/). The engine computes PCB and CP38; submission is external

obligations.description: Notice of a new employee (CP22)
obligations.trigger: Commencing to employ an individual who is or is likely to be chargeable to tax
obligations.timing: Not later than one month after the commencement
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(2) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf)

obligations.description: Cessation or departure notice (CP22A / CP21) and withholding of money
obligations.trigger: An employee ceasing employment, retiring, or leaving Malaysia for more than three months
obligations.timing: Not less than one month before cessation or departure, through e-SPC from 1 January 2024 (no CP22A where the income is subject to MTD, or below the MTD threshold, and the individual is not retiring); money payable withheld until ninety days after HASiL receives the notice, unless HASiL permits earlier
obligations.owner: Payroll and HR / e-SPC notice and clearance letter
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(3)-(5) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf); HASiL notification of termination (https://www.hasil.gov.my/en/majikan/pemberitahuan-pemberhentian-kerja/). The engine raises a disbursement hold from payroll.tax_clearance

obligations.description: Annual remuneration statement to each employee (Form EA)
obligations.timing: Prepared and rendered to the employee on or before the last day of February of the following year
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(1A); HASiL employer responsibilities (https://www.hasil.gov.my/en/majikan/tanggungjawab-majikan/)

obligations.description: Employer's return (Form E) with the CP8D employee particulars
obligations.timing: On or before 31 March of the following year; Form E is incomplete without CP8D
obligations.authority: Income Tax Act 1967 s.83(1) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/LOM/EN/Act%2053.pdf); HASiL employer responsibilities (https://www.hasil.gov.my/en/majikan/tanggungjawab-majikan/)

obligations.description: Minimum wage
obligations.timing: RM1,700 a month (the hourly and daily equivalents for other rates) under the Minimum Wages Order 2024, in force for every employer from 1 August 2025
obligations.authority: National Wages Consultative Council Act 2011; Minimum Wages Order 2024 (https://gajiminimum.mohr.gov.my/). The engine warns on a covered contract below the floor

obligations.description: Retrenchment notification (Borang PK)
obligations.trigger: Retrenchment by reason of redundancy or closure
obligations.timing: Parts I-IV received by the Labour Department at least 30 days before the retrenchment; Part V within 14 days after; Part VI within 30 days after. Foreign employees in a similar capacity are terminated first (s.60N)
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.60N, 63 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf); Pemberitahuan Pemberhentian Kerja 2004, P.U.(B) 430/2004 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/ms/soalan-lazim/pemberhentian-pekerja; https://www.jtksabah.gov.my/index.php/ms/sumber/media/koleksi-pengumuman/64-perkhidmatan/majikan/164-pemberhentian-pekerja.html)

obligations.description: Notice, termination benefits and final wages
obligations.trigger: Termination of a contract of service
obligations.timing: Notice under s.12(2) (four, six or eight weeks by service) or indemnity in lieu; termination benefits under the Termination and Lay-Off Benefits Regulations 1980; final wages not later than the day the contract ends (s.20, s.21(1)), or the third day after it where the employee left without notice (s.21(2))
obligations.owner: HR and Payroll / service calculation and payment receipt
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.12, 13, 20, 21, 60J (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf). The engine prices TERMINATION_BENEFIT and NOTICE_IN_LIEU and warns FINAL_PAY_LATE

obligations.description: Paternity leave eligibility and notice
obligations.timing: Seven consecutive days per confinement, up to five confinements, after twelve months with the employer; the employee notifies the pregnancy at least thirty days before the expected confinement or as early as possible after the birth
obligations.owner: HR / notice, marriage and confinement evidence
obligations.authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60FA(1)-(3) (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/sites/default/files/2023-11/Akta%20Kerja%201955%20(Akta%20265).pdf)

obligations.description: Work authorisation, privacy and workplace safety
obligations.timing: Per the applicable instrument
obligations.owner: HR / applicable-law register, permits and retained evidence
obligations.authority: Separate compliance review required; these areas are not implemented by the payroll engine
